system.description:
Cyber Cost: 3

Gain Half Access to Blackwall. When you roll with Fear using a Blackwall card, gain 1 Corruption, max 2. Before a Blackwall roll, spend any Corruption to roll that many d6s and add them to the roll. If you spend 2 Corruption and succeed, affected targets marks 1 Stress and becomes temporarily Degraded. While Degraded, the target uses a d12 instead of a d20 for attack rolls. Then mark a Stress or the GM gains a Fear.
